newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Food poisoning hits 500 tourists to Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Food poisoning hits 500 tourists to Australia.

text.p: About 500 tourists to Australia suffered food poisoning after eating chocolate sauce served on flights between Cairns and Asia, health authorities said on Monday.
Queensland state Health Minister Mike Horan said the salmonella outbreak had affected passengers on Qantas Airways Ltd flights out of Cairns to Japan and Taiwan from November 3-7.
Most of the reported cases had been in Japan, but Horan said several cases had also been reported in Israel, Norway and Canada.
"The figures we've been given is that it's not just there (Japan), it's from other parts of the world as well and in the order of 500 people," he said at a media briefing.
The contaminated sauce had been destroyed and investigations were continuing into how it came to be contaminated.
Queensland health authorities said last week about 100 people had been affected by the outbreak and 21 hospitalised.
A Qantas spokesman said on Monday the company was paying bona fide medical expenses for affected passengers and assessing claims for compensation on a case by case basis.
